evidence.basis: Effective accelerating power-delivery calibration, 0.82 rather than generic 0.88: resolves engine-limited 60–100 mph overperformance while retaining the improved launch and independently set lateral grip. Includes unresolved losses/rotational dynamics in this reduced-order model; not a measured OEM mechanical efficiency or a dyno claim. Reference 4.3 s to 60 and 9.7 s to 100; unknown rollout largely cancels in the 5.4 s interval. Quarter-mile crossing speed retained as a separate diagnostic. See docs/verification/gt500-midrange/README.md for interventions, guardrails and limitations.
